title: Testing for peer effects in short panels without identifying the network structure
abstract: arXiv:2610.31106v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose an instrument-based test for peer effects in short-T panels when the underlying network is unknown. The test avoids estimating the network by aggregating pairwise comparisons between covariate-projected outcomes of potential peers and residualized own outcomes. The statistic is designed for fixed-T, large-N settings with individual fixed effects, heterogeneous slopes, heteroskedasticity, and serial dependence within units. We also develop a weighted extension that accounts for additive common time effects. The limiting distribution is standard Gaussian when the norm of the projected component of the outcomes is bounded away from zero, but can be nonstandard when it is local to zero. We derive a conditional Gaussian limit experiment and a feasible conditional Monte Carlo procedure to obtain uniformly valid critical values. Monte Carlo evidence shows that the conditional procedure leads to accurate size control while retaining p

translated_title: 在无需识别网络结构的情况下检验短面板中的同伴效应
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种基于工具变量的检验方法，用于在潜在网络未知时检验短面板（T较短）中的同伴效应。该检验通过聚合潜在同伴的协变量投影结果与自身残差化结果之间的两两比较，避免了网络估计问题。该统计量设计适用于固定T、大N的设定，允许个体固定效应、异质性斜率、异方差性以及单元内的序列相关性。我们还开发了一个加权扩展，以考虑可加的共同时间效应。当结果投影分量的范数有界远离零时，极限分布为标准高斯分布；但当其局部趋近于零时，极限分布可能是非标准的。我们推导了条件高斯极限实验以及一种可行的条件蒙特卡洛程序，以获得一致有效的临界值。蒙特卡洛证据表明，条件程序能够实现精确的规模控制，同时保持检验功效。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于工具变量的检验方法，可在网络结构未知的情况下检验短面板中的同伴效应，并通过条件蒙特卡洛程序获得一致有效的临界值，从而实现精确的检验规模控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an instrument-based test for peer effects in short panels that requires no identification of the underlying network structure, and develops a conditional Monte Carlo procedure to obtain uniformly valid critical values with accurate size control.
